run_summarization_finetuning: run a seq2seq summarization model fine-tuning script on Habana Gaudi with HuggingFace transformers
create_summarization_dataset: create a summarization dataset from CSV or JSON files with text and summary columns
build_preprocess_function: build a preprocessing function that tokenizes input text and target summaries for seq2seq training
evaluate_rouge_metrics: evaluate summarization model predictions using ROUGE metrics with NLTK sentence tokenization
configure_gaudi_trainer: configure a GaudiSeq2SeqTrainer with model, datasets, data collator, and ROUGE compute metrics
